newsitem.title: UK: AB Foods down after broker downgrades.
newsitem.headline: AB Foods down after broker downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Associated British Foods Plc dropped on Wednesday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson downgraded their recommendations on the stock, traders said.
Market sources said Kleinwort had cut the stock to a "sell" from a "hold" while Hoare Govett lowered to "hold" from "buy" and said fair value for the foods group was between 450p and 455p.
AB Foods shares were down 9p at 471 by 0938 GMT, extending their retreat since they climbed to a record 494p on January 6.
Analysts at neither brokerage were immediately available for comment.
